notebook.starterData:
# Synthetic data: 750 days of prices (not real market data)
prices = qla.load("ceny-gbm")["close"]
prices.tail()
notebook.starterStats:
import numpy as np

returns = np.log(prices).diff().dropna()
show(prices, label="Price")
hist(returns, bins=40, label="Daily log returns")
print(f"mean {returns.mean():.5f}, sd {returns.std():.4f}")
